title: Report transport safety matters to the ATSB
what: A responsible person who knows of an immediately reportable transport safety matter must report it to a nominated official as soon as reasonably practicable.

sources.title: Transport Safety Investigation Act 2003
sources.quote: 18 Immediate reports (1) If a responsible person has knowledge of an immediately reportable matter, then the person must report it to a nominated official as soon as is reasonably practicable, by the means prescribed by the regulations and including those of the particulars prescribed by the regulations that are known to the responsible person.

reach.condition: if it operates aircraft, ships or trains covered by the Act

assessment.summary: Responsible persons must report immediately reportable and routine reportable transport safety matters to a nominated official.
